verdict.rationale: The docs provide copy-and-run code examples across many SDKs, the CLI and the REST API (a quickstart parse call and per-product example galleries for Parse, Extract, Split and Classify). Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference, such as a try-it console or explorable endpoint docs. The probe also found no public OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the standard paths. missing for 10: interactive API reference/try-it console, published OpenAPI spec, evidence that examples are executable in-browser, independent corroboration.
